acceptance: Qwen Image 3.0 text prompts use synchronous Images API on the configured endpoint with selected key; no tools/thinking/stream/async flags.

Returned safe image URLs render in Markdown; no fabricated token metering. Cancellation, error and unsupported attachment paths tested with mocks.
Local deployment and browser rendering verified; real account generation is a separate acceptance gate.
